ambient: It moves on to the next part, at the correct speed.
The buzzing rises through something you hadn't thought about in years.
A pause, and the sense of a note being made.
description: It has started at the beginning and it's going to do all of it. Your life, in order, at the correct speed, with somebody attentive sitting just off to one side. Nothing is being skipped. There's a dry electrical buzzing through all of it, head to foot.
name: The Screening

looks: Dry, electrical, total. It's in your teeth and your heels.
It's the projector, in some sense you won't be able to explain later.
It gets louder at the parts that matter.
objects.name: the buzzing

looks: Attentive. Not judging. Taking it in properly, which is worse.
They have been here for all of it and will stay for the rest.
They're waiting for you to say something about this part.
objects.name: the one sitting off to one side

weather: A dry electrical warmth, head to foot, that rises at the parts that matter.
